overview_description.description: Boostly provides behavioral-based and gamified SMS marketing for restaurants. Boostly seamlessly connects with all sources of customer data (e.g. POS, online ordering, reservations, phone, etc), and builds a list of opted-in subscribers faster than anyone. Boostly then engages consumers based on their interaction with the brand, driving immense revenue to the restaurant in the process.
